notes.title: Updates are back!
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATES ARE BACK![/h1]
[h2]What happened[/h2]
Almost 8 months ago, I lost about 20% of the files of the game, I thought it would be over but thanks to everybody playing the game, I finally got the motivation to redo every scripts that I lost and now I am happy to announce that I will be able to create new content for the game!

[h1]IN THIS UPDATE[/h1]
[h2]Rework of the whole Twitch Integration to have a more stable connection to the chat[/h2]
Before, the chat sometimes wouldn't connect automaticly and you needed to press a button,
it's now fixed, and it should always connect!
[h2]Updated some UI elements[/h2]
Improved kill feed, now show how the dead AI was killed
Some buttons looks better now (in my opinion)

[h2]Released a new game![/h2]
I've also released a new game if you guys are interested!
The name is [b]Let Chat Guess[/b] and it is available on Steam!

[h2]There might be some new bugs[/h2]
Since I redid 20% of the game, there might be some new bugs that were not there before, but don't worry, if there is, I will do my best to correct them!

notes.title: Less camping - More fun !
notes.content:
To decrease the camping, I've done some changes !

[b]1. AI's with snipers/shotguns/boxing gloves can no longer see other guns on the ground[/b]
 - This change is made so AI's that have guns won't camp near a gun on the ground.

[b]2. AI's with no gun, won't see other AI's[/b]
 - AI's are smart. When they see another AI that doesn't have a gun, they tend to stay in group like fishes, and dance together.
Making unarmed AI's not see other unarmed AI's will fix this.

[b]3.  Guns son the ground now have a bigger detection zone[/b]
 - AI's are dumb. Sometime they see a gun on the ground and what do they do? They dance around it.
Making the detection zone bigger means that if they dance around it, there's more chance they pick up the gun
